ORDER With the consent of the parties, matter is heard finally.

2. As per the learned counsel for the appellant that this appeal under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant/claimant for enhancement of compensation of Rs.10,00,000/- by paying Court fees of Rs.25,000/- in MVC No.2580 of 2019 (Faiz Mohammad vs.
Ramkumar Kewat and others) wherein the learned 21st Additional Member, Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Bhopal vide award dated 23/06/2022 has awarded compensation of Rs.15,63,871/- to appellant/claimant who has sustained injuries in motor accident dated 02/08/2019.

It is further submitted that on the date of accident minimum wages was of Rs.7700/- per month but the Tribunal took the minimum wages @ Rs.5625/- per month for calculation purpose, therefore, there is an error in calculation of compensation.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondents has supported the impugned award and claimed dismissal of instant appeal.

However, he did not dispute that on the date of accident, as per Faiz Mohammad vs Ramkumar Kewat on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37512552/
1 notification of the State Government, the minimum wages of Rs.7700/- per month.
5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the disability certificate Ex.P/280, this Court is of the view that by taking 35% permanent disability and monthly income @
Rs.7700/- per month, the correct calculation would be as follows :-
(i) Monthly income = Rs.7700/-
(ii) Annual income = Rs.92400/-
(iii) On adding 40% future Income = Rs.92,400/-+36,900/-
= Rs.1,29,360/-
(iv) Multiplier by 17 (age of 28 yrs) = Rs.1,29,360 x 17 = 21,99,120/-

( v ) 35% towards disability = 21,99,120 x 35% = Rs.7,69,692/-
(vi) Amount towards medial expenses and other expenses = 9,37,246/-
(vii) Mental pain and suffering = Rs.1,50,000/-
( viii
) Special diet and attender = Rs.25,000/-

(ix) Transportation = 
 (x) expenses on meals for his family member = 
 NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17338  3

Total compensation = Rs.
7.
Hence, the amount of compensation, to which the appellant/claimant would be entitled to, is Rs.19,31,938/-.
The Tribunal has already awarded sum of Faiz Mohammad vs Ramkumar Kewat on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37512552/
Hence, the compensation enhanced by Rs.3,68,067/- (Rs.19,31,938 - Rs.15,63,871).
8. Therefore, the compensation is enhanced by Rs.3,68,067/.
However, the other terms and conditions of the impugned award passed by Tribunal including rate of interest are kept intact.
9 . With the aforesaid observation, this appeal is partly allowed and disposed of.
